title: 1956 Montgolfier vacuum tests in Paris

tellings.quote: But in 1956, Jean-Louis Cornillon, a French Air Force officer and technical representative for one of France's largest aircraft companies, Sud Aviation, facilitated Brown's experiments in a vacuum in the Montgolfier facility in Paris.

plain: In 1956, the American inventor Townsend Brown, whom the episode calls a CIA scientist who built UFO-like craft, is said to have tested his devices inside a vacuum at the Montgolfier facility in Paris. Michels tells it himself, drawing on a document he calls the Montgolfier report and on a man named Paul Schatzkin: the tests were arranged by Jean-Louis Cornillon, "a French Air Force officer and technical representative" for the large French aircraft company Sud Aviation. If true, it shows Brown's work drew serious interest from the French aviation world.
